title: Back to the Wooden Sword
description: Weed collects the silver he earned. Now another quest is tempting him away from the work he began.
script:
story 2
label opening
scene shop
ambience none
show Hyun happy left
show Shopkeeper happy right
look Hyun Shopkeeper
look Shopkeeper Hyun
camera two Hyun Shopkeeper cut
I: 离开老侍女的家，我回到雕像店。任务做完了，奖励还没拿呢。
Shopkeeper [happy]: 维德，这么快就知道是怎么回事了！真是谢谢你。
Shopkeeper [happy]: 让你去做这个任务，看来我没找错人。
choice thanks
option modest "能帮上忙，我也很开心。" -> modest
option trust "谢谢您愿意相信我。" -> trust
label modest
I: 我点点头。老板很开心，接下来，是不是该给奖励了？
goto payment
label trust
I: 他第一次见我时，可不是这样。现在，终于觉得找对人了。
label payment
I: 老板给了我两枚银币。拿到手里的钱，才是真的。
I: 吟游诗人拿走的那枚银币，终于赚回来了！
choice coins
option cost "我想想那一枚银币。" -> cost
option gain "我看看这两枚银币。" -> gain
label cost
I: 那时候，一不小心就让他拿走了。现在想起来，还是心疼。
goto return
label gain
I: 两枚！不只把花出去的钱赚回来，还多了一枚。
label return
scene hall
ambience hall
show Hyun happy left
show Instructor happy right
look Hyun Instructor
look Instructor Hyun
camera two Hyun Instructor cut
I: 我又回到训练场。教官也说我做得好，还给了一枚银币。
Instructor [happy]: 做得不错。
I: 一开始的两枚，老板的两枚，还有教官的一枚。
I: 这次，前前后后，一共拿到了五枚银币。
I: 给吟游诗人花了一枚，手里还有四枚。
I: 钱赚到了，我也已经从一级，变成了三级。
I: 等级提高以后得到的点数，我一半用来提高力量，一半用来提高敏捷。
choice stats
option strong "我想想手里的剑会不会更有力。" -> strong
option quick "我想想自己会不会更快。" -> quick
label strong
I: 力量越大，同样的一剑，也就更有力。
goto temptation
label quick
I: 敏捷提高了，出剑的时候，也就更快了。
label temptation
scene hall
ambience hall
show Hyun curious left
show Dummy neutral right
look Hyun front
camera listener Hyun cut
Hyun [curious]: 为什么不再接一个任务呢？
I: 我刚出去一次，就拿到了钱，等级也提高了。
I: 再去找个任务，好像比一直打木头人有意思多了。
choice next
option money "我想想刚到手的奖励。" -> money
option sword "我看看那把一直用的木剑。" -> sword
label money
I: 钱当然很好。可这么特别的任务，不是想找就能找到的。
goto choose
label sword
I: 我已经练习了这么久。刚赚到一点钱，就不练习了吗？
label choose
express Hyun determined
look Hyun Dummy
prop Hyun sword
camera action Hyun Dummy cut
I: 心里还想去接任务，我却又拿出了木剑。
activity Hyun train Dummy steady
I: 木剑又打在木头人身上。我回来了。
I: 这次任务给的奖励，对我这个等级来说，已经很多了。
I: 可这样的好事，不会每次都有。眼前能做的，还是练习。
I: 这一次，我选木剑。它能带我走到哪里？
end

Hyun.name: 李贤 · Lee Hyun
Hyun.provenance: Based on David’s approved Fantasy RPG hero lineup poster (2026-10-23). Hand-authored supported polished articulated SVG approximation; costume details beyond shared geometry are not reproduced. Future episodes only; original released packs remain unchanged.

Shopkeeper.name: 店主 · Sculpture shopkeeper
Shopkeeper.provenance: Original fictional sculpture-shop keeper for the personal LMS adaptation. Shared polished SVG builder, distinct round face, tidy side-part, short beard and muted sage merchant robe; not official artwork.

Instructor.name: 教官 · Instructor
Instructor.provenance: Original fictional Training Hall instructor, shared polished SVG character; not official artwork.

Dummy.name: 稻草人 · Training dummy
Dummy.provenance: Original hand-authored vector straw training dummy rendered to transparent WebP. Inanimate standalone stage character. Paired choreography moves its whole body; no human facial or limb rig.

Watcher.name: 旁边的人 · Onlooker

sources: Personal Mandarin adaptation of fingerprinted first-compilation Chapter 3, The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor. Farewell and collection of shopkeeper/instructor rewards through the return to the wooden sword. Includes the chapter’s final two explanatory sentences about rare quests and unusually generous rewards. No Chapter 4 events.

离开老侍女的家，我回到雕像店。任务做完了，奖励还没拿呢。.english: After leaving the elderly attendant's home, I return to the sculpture shop. The quests are done, but I have not collected the rewards yet.
离开老侍女的家，我回到雕像店。任务做完了，奖励还没拿呢。.pinyin: lí kāi lǎo shì nǚ de jiā ， wǒ huí dào diāo xiàng diàn 。 rèn wu zuò wán le ， jiǎng lì hái méi ná ne 。

interlinear.gloss: After leaving the elderly attendant's home,
interlinear.pinyin: lí kāi lǎo shì nǚ de jiā ，

interlinear.gloss: I return to the sculpture shop.
interlinear.pinyin: wǒ huí dào diāo xiàng diàn 。

interlinear.gloss: but I have not collected the rewards yet.
interlinear.pinyin: jiǎng lì hái méi ná ne 。

维德，这么快就知道是怎么回事了！真是谢谢你。.english: Weed, you found out what happened so quickly! Thank you so much.
维德，这么快就知道是怎么回事了！真是谢谢你。.pinyin: wéi dé ， zhè me kuài jiù zhī dào shì zěn me huí shì le ！ zhēn shì xiè xiè nǐ 。

interlinear.chinese: 这么快就知道是怎么回事了！
interlinear.gloss: you found out what happened so quickly!
interlinear.pinyin: zhè me kuài jiù zhī dào shì zěn me huí shì le ！

让你去做这个任务，看来我没找错人。.english: Having you do this quest, it seems I chose the right person.
让你去做这个任务，看来我没找错人。.pinyin: ràng nǐ qù zuò zhè ge rèn wu ， kàn lái wǒ méi zhǎo cuò rén 。

interlinear.pinyin: ràng nǐ qù zuò zhè ge rèn wu ，

interlinear.gloss: it seems I chose the right person.
interlinear.pinyin: kàn lái wǒ méi zhǎo cuò rén 。

能帮上忙，我也很开心。.english: I could help, and I am happy about that too.
能帮上忙，我也很开心。.pinyin: néng bāng shàng máng ， wǒ yě hěn kāi xīn 。

interlinear.gloss: and I am happy about that too.

谢谢您愿意相信我。.english: Thank you for being willing to trust me.
谢谢您愿意相信我。.pinyin: xiè xiè nín yuàn yì xiāng xìn wǒ 。

interlinear.gloss: for being willing to trust me.

我点点头。老板很开心，接下来，是不是该给奖励了？.english: I nod. The shopkeeper is happy; next, is it time for the reward?
我点点头。老板很开心，接下来，是不是该给奖励了？.pinyin: wǒ diǎn diǎn tóu 。 lǎo bǎn hěn kāi xīn ， jiē xià lái ， shì bu shì gāi gěi jiǎng lì le ？

interlinear.gloss: is it time for the reward?
interlinear.pinyin: shì bu shì gāi gěi jiǎng lì le ？

他第一次见我时，可不是这样。现在，终于觉得找对人了。.english: When he first saw me, he certainly was not like this. Now, he finally thinks he found the right person.
他第一次见我时，可不是这样。现在，终于觉得找对人了。.pinyin: tā dì yī cì jiàn wǒ shí ， kě bú shì zhè yàng 。 xiàn zài ， zhōng yú jué de zhǎo duì rén le 。

interlinear.pinyin: tā dì yī cì jiàn wǒ shí ，

interlinear.gloss: he certainly was not like this.
he finally thinks he found the right person.
interlinear.pinyin: zhōng yú jué de zhǎo duì rén le 。

老板给了我两枚银币。拿到手里的钱，才是真的。.english: The shopkeeper gives me two silver coins. Money actually in my hand is the real thing.
老板给了我两枚银币。拿到手里的钱，才是真的。.pinyin: lǎo bǎn gěi le wǒ liǎng méi yín bì 。 ná dào shǒu lǐ de qián ， cái shì zhēn de 。

interlinear.gloss: The shopkeeper gives me two silver coins.
interlinear.pinyin: lǎo bǎn gěi le wǒ liǎng méi yín bì 。
ná dào shǒu lǐ de qián ，

吟游诗人拿走的那枚银币，终于赚回来了！.english: The bard took that silver coin; I have finally earned it back!
吟游诗人拿走的那枚银币，终于赚回来了！.pinyin: yín yóu shī rén ná zǒu de nà méi yín bì ， zhōng yú zhuàn huí lái le ！

interlinear.pinyin: ná zǒu de nà méi yín bì ，

interlinear.gloss: I have finally earned it back!
interlinear.pinyin: zhōng yú zhuàn huí lái le ！

我想想那一枚银币。.english: I think about that one silver coin.
我想想那一枚银币。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiǎng nà yì méi yín bì 。

我看看这两枚银币。.english: I look at these two silver coins.
我看看这两枚银币。.pinyin: wǒ kàn kàn zhè liǎng méi yín bì 。

那时候，一不小心就让他拿走了。现在想起来，还是心疼。.english: Back then, one careless moment let him take it. Even thinking about it now, it still hurts.
那时候，一不小心就让他拿走了。现在想起来，还是心疼。.pinyin: nà shí hòu ， yí bù xiǎo xīn jiù ràng tā ná zǒu le 。 xiàn zài xiǎng qǐ lái ， hái shì xīn téng 。

interlinear.pinyin: jiù ràng tā ná zǒu le 。

两枚！不只把花出去的钱赚回来，还多了一枚。.english: Two coins! Not only did I earn back what I spent, there is another coin on top.
两枚！不只把花出去的钱赚回来，还多了一枚。.pinyin: liǎng méi ！ bù zhǐ bǎ huā chū qù de qián zhuàn huí lái ， hái duō le yì méi 。

interlinear.chinese: 不只把花出去的钱赚回来，
interlinear.gloss: Not only did I earn back what I spent,
interlinear.pinyin: bù zhǐ bǎ huā chū qù de qián zhuàn huí lái ，

interlinear.gloss: there is another coin on top.

我又回到训练场。教官也说我做得好，还给了一枚银币。.english: I return to the training hall. The instructor also says I did well, and gives me another silver coin.
我又回到训练场。教官也说我做得好，还给了一枚银币。.pinyin: wǒ yòu huí dào xùn liàn chǎng 。 jiào guān yě shuō wǒ zuò de hǎo ， hái gěi le yì méi yín bì 。

interlinear.gloss: I return to the training hall.
interlinear.pinyin: wǒ yòu huí dào xùn liàn chǎng 。

interlinear.gloss: The instructor also says I did well,
interlinear.pinyin: jiào guān yě shuō wǒ zuò de hǎo ，

interlinear.gloss: and gives me another silver coin.
interlinear.pinyin: hái gěi le yì méi yín bì 。

一开始的两枚，老板的两枚，还有教官的一枚。.english: The original two, the shopkeeper's two, and the instructor's one.
一开始的两枚，老板的两枚，还有教官的一枚。.pinyin: yì kāi shǐ de liǎng méi ， lǎo bǎn de liǎng méi ， hái yǒu jiào guān de yì méi 。

interlinear.pinyin: yì kāi shǐ de liǎng méi ，
hái yǒu jiào guān de yì méi 。

这次，前前后后，一共拿到了五枚银币。.english: This time, all told, I received five silver coins in total.
这次，前前后后，一共拿到了五枚银币。.pinyin: zhè cì ， qián qián hòu hòu ， yí gòng ná dào le wǔ méi yín bì 。

interlinear.gloss: I received five silver coins in total.
interlinear.pinyin: yí gòng ná dào le wǔ méi yín bì 。

给吟游诗人花了一枚，手里还有四枚。.english: One was spent on the bard; I still have four in hand.
给吟游诗人花了一枚，手里还有四枚。.pinyin: gěi yín yóu shī rén huā le yì méi ， shǒu lǐ hái yǒu sì méi 。

interlinear.gloss: One was spent on the bard;
interlinear.pinyin: gěi yín yóu shī rén huā le yì méi ，

interlinear.gloss: I still have four in hand.
interlinear.pinyin: shǒu lǐ hái yǒu sì méi 。

钱赚到了，我也已经从一级，变成了三级。.english: I earned money, and I have already gone from level one to level three.
钱赚到了，我也已经从一级，变成了三级。.pinyin: qián zhuàn dào le ， wǒ yě yǐ jīng cóng yī jí ， biàn chéng le sān jí 。

interlinear.gloss: and I have already gone from level one
interlinear.pinyin: wǒ yě yǐ jīng cóng yī jí ，

我想想手里的剑会不会更有力。.english: I consider whether the sword in my hand will strike harder.
我想想手里的剑会不会更有力。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiǎng shǒu lǐ de jiàn huì bu huì gèng yǒu lì 。

interlinear.chinese: 手里的剑会不会更有力。
interlinear.gloss: whether the sword in my hand will strike harder.
interlinear.pinyin: shǒu lǐ de jiàn huì bu huì gèng yǒu lì 。

我想想自己会不会更快。.english: I consider whether I will be quicker.
我想想自己会不会更快。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiǎng zì jǐ huì bu huì gèng kuài 。

interlinear.pinyin: zì jǐ huì bu huì gèng kuài 。

力量越大，同样的一剑，也就更有力。.english: The greater my Strength, the same sword strike will have more force.
力量越大，同样的一剑，也就更有力。.pinyin: lì liàng yuè dà ， tóng yàng de yí jiàn ， yě jiù gèng yǒu lì 。

敏捷提高了，出剑的时候，也就更快了。.english: With increased Agility, when I swing the sword, it will be quicker too.
敏捷提高了，出剑的时候，也就更快了。.pinyin: mǐn jié tí gāo le ， chū jiàn de shí hòu ， yě jiù gèng kuài le 。

为什么不再接一个任务呢？.pinyin: wèi shén me bú zài jiē yí gè rèn wu ne ？

interlinear.pinyin: bú zài jiē yí gè rèn wu ne ？

我刚出去一次，就拿到了钱，等级也提高了。.english: I just went out once, and got money, and my level increased too.
我刚出去一次，就拿到了钱，等级也提高了。.pinyin: wǒ gāng chū qù yí cì ， jiù ná dào le qián ， děng jí yě tí gāo le 。

interlinear.pinyin: wǒ gāng chū qù yí cì ，
děng jí yě tí gāo le 。

再去找个任务，好像比一直打木头人有意思多了。.english: Finding another quest seems better than continually striking a training dummy: much more interesting.
再去找个任务，好像比一直打木头人有意思多了。.pinyin: zài qù zhǎo gè rèn wu ， hǎo xiàng bǐ yì zhí dǎ mù tou rén yǒu yì si duō le 。

interlinear.pinyin: zài qù zhǎo gè rèn wu ，

interlinear.gloss: seems better than continually striking a training dummy:
interlinear.pinyin: hǎo xiàng bǐ yì zhí dǎ mù tou rén

我想想刚到手的奖励。.english: I think about the reward I have just received.
我想想刚到手的奖励。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiǎng gāng dào shǒu de jiǎng lì 。

interlinear.gloss: the reward I have just received.
interlinear.pinyin: gāng dào shǒu de jiǎng lì 。

我看看那把一直用的木剑。.english: I look at the wooden sword I have been using all along.
我看看那把一直用的木剑。.pinyin: wǒ kàn kàn nà bǎ yì zhí yòng de mù jiàn 。

interlinear.gloss: the wooden sword I have been using all along.
interlinear.pinyin: nà bǎ yì zhí yòng de mù jiàn 。

钱当然很好。可这么特别的任务，不是想找就能找到的。.english: Money is certainly good. But a quest this special cannot be found just because you want one.
钱当然很好。可这么特别的任务，不是想找就能找到的。.pinyin: qián dāng rán hěn hǎo 。 kě zhè me tè bié de rèn wu ， bú shì xiǎng zhǎo jiù néng zhǎo dào de 。

interlinear.pinyin: kě zhè me tè bié de rèn wu ，

interlinear.gloss: cannot be found just because you want one.
